name: Five Star Solutions Call Center (Partner)
desc:
Retirement Services Associate | $15/hr + $1/hr night and weekend differential | Full-Time, Remote, Inbound calls, emails and voicemails, no sales expected
Company: Five Star Solutions
Industry: Finance

What a typical day will look like:
You help people who have retirement plan accounts. They call, email, or leave voicemails with questions about distributions and account issues, and you give clear, accurate answers. You use several systems at once, including Salesforce, Excel, and the plan website, and you document every case in Salesforce. You also create tickets for things like check copies, 1099-Rs, and stop and reissue of funds. When something is too complex, you pass it to a supervisor. It is steady, detail-focused service work, and you may be cross trained on other accounts.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and patience on the phone
- Attention to detail
- Staying calm and professional in a fast-paced setting
- Keeping information confidential
- Reliable attendance and teamwork
assessment: Company specifically states AI-assisted application screening is utilized. Applicants should expect interview screening and potentially customer service assessments.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting.
Required Experience: None required. 1 year of customer service, call center, or office experience preferred. Must be 18 or older.
Preferred Experience: Finance or retirement services background.
Required Skills:
- Strong verbal and written communication
- Comfortable with billing and account information
- Strong attention to detail
- Able to move between multiple computer systems
- Comfortable cross training on other accounts
- Verified, dedicated high speed internet with a direct LAN connection, and a dedicated work area (desk, chair, outlet)

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has a year of customer service, call center, or office experience
- Likes detail work and getting answers right
- Wants a steady Monday through Friday schedule with paid training
- Is interested in finance or retirement benefits

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Cannot be available between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM Central, Monday through Friday
- Does not have a dedicated work area and wired internet
- Dislikes working with account and billing details
- Does not want to cross train on other accounts
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or emailed directly to you
3. If the assessment is passing, watch for an email or text from a recruiter for a phone screen
4. If the phone screen goes well, expect a final interview
This is an estimated process. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.

Top 10 resume keywords:
- Customer service
- Retirement plan services
- Inbound call handling
- Salesforce
- Case documentation
- Account inquiries
- Microsoft Excel and Word
- Attention to detail
- Confidentiality
- Problem resolution

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell me about your customer service or office experience.
- How do you stay accurate when you are working in several systems at once?
- Tell me about a time you helped an upset customer. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- Tell me about a time you found a mistake in your work and fixed it. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- How do you feel about learning new accounts and cross training?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:

-Pay: $15/hr, plus a $1/hr shift differential for nights and weekends.

-Shift: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Must be available between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM Central.

-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k. The posting does not list benefits, so confirm with the recruiter.

-Equipment Provided: Yes. You need verified, dedicated high speed internet with a direct LAN connection and a dedicated work area (desk, chair, electrical outlet).

-Felony Friendly? Case by case. A background check is required in line with state and federal laws.

-Drug Test: Certain positions.

-Notes: Oklahoma is listed as an eligible state for this remote role. Paid training is typically 1 week, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central. The posting says you will be cross trained on other accounts, and you may help with web-based training sessions for clients.

-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Retirement Services Associate → Senior Retirement Services Associate → Team Lead → Client Services Supervisor → Operations Manager.
training: Paid training, typically 1 week, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central
